name: Reporting
definition: Fund and investment reports, quarterly reports, financial statements, audit-support requests.

name: Distribution / Share Delivery
definition: Firm-initiated payouts: in-kind (SpaceX) and cash distributions, DTC/brokerage delivery details, eligibility questions.

name: Capital Call
definition: Capital-call notices, wire/payment confirmations, receipt queries, management fees.

name: Subscription Docs
definition: Subscription/onboarding paperwork, capital commitments, signature support, custody feedback.

name: Tax Docs
definition: K-1s, tax information requests, W-8/W-9, tax-document delivery timelines.

name: Account Admin
definition: Portal access, address/email/contact changes, distribution-list edits, ownership transfers between an investor's own entities.

name: Carta Onboarding
definition: Getting onto or through Carta: activation, portal access, e-signature problems.

name: Meeting
definition: Scheduling calls, intros, business-update invitations, networking.

name: Capital Account
definition: Per-investor capital-account statements: requests, resends, discrepancies.

name: Valuation
definition: Current valuation, NAV, price-per-share, carry estimates, portfolio-value questions.

name: Co-Investment
definition: Co-invest and follow-on opportunity notices and investor elections.

name: KYC / AML
definition: Identity documents, outstanding KYC, FATCA/CRS, compliance verification.

name: Liquidity / Transfer
definition: Investor-initiated secondary transfers or redemptions of an existing interest.

name: Legal
definition: Side letters, consents, NDAs, and other legal terms.

name: Other
definition: Genuinely uncategorised investor mail. Noise (auto-replies, undeliverables) is dropped by the noise gate, not filed here.

name: NDA
definition: Retired in v3 - merged into Legal. Kept inactive for historical lineage.

name: Legal Side Letter
definition: Retired in v3 - merged into Legal. Kept inactive for historical lineage.

name: Brokerage Details
definition: Retired in v3 - merged into Distribution. Kept inactive for historical lineage.

name: Data Room
definition: Retired in v3 - kept inactive for historical lineage.
